note: canonical back view (azimuth 180); rows/cols are continuous canonical pixel coordinates

patchRule.aboveEar: y over the ear front..back, z from the ear top to +10 mm
patchRule.sideburn: y from 12 mm in front of the ear front edge to the ear front edge, z from the tragus to the ear top
patchRule.reference: same side, y from the sideburn front to the ear back, z from ear top +20 to +40 mm (temporal scalp above both patches)
